Name: Kenneth's Armory
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Armory[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]49 blades for Kenneth's Weapon Shop. A big mix of swords, daggers, and blades for every kind of fighter.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]49 blades in Kenneth's Weapon Shop - Shop1, all with that stocked armory feel. Some are small and fast, some are steady for everyday use, and some are heavy and hit hard. Swords, daggers, cleavers, axes, spears, and sickles are in there, in all kinds of shapes and styles.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Check Kenneth's Weapon Shop - Shop1 in game when you have time, and see which one fits how you play.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Weapon Shop - Shop1[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Each blade is sold once a day. You buy it with gold plus bars / gems, so bring both when you stop by.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Go to Kenneth's Weapon Shop, Shop1.[/b][/size]
[b][size=4]• Take a look at what is for sale.[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]• Buy the one you like. Shop only, no quests, no crafting.[/size][/b]

[size=4][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Weapon Shop - you need this so Shop1 shows up[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Make sure Kenneth's Weapon Shop is also installed.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Start the game and check Shop1.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. Works with the other swords from Kenneth's Weapon Shop. You can add it in the middle of a save, no need to start a new game.[/b][/size]
